text:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD#B-11072 — hosted-inference eu-west-2 multiple 5xxs detected (severity: high). Incident link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/B-11072

alex (oncall): getting the page now, acking via PD web. mobile shows a weird stale state, might be PD mobile cache. acked in web at 3629876550.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: secondary didn't ack within 90s; paging manager (maria) per policy 'prod-critical-escalation'. SMS+call attempted.

kevin: I didn't get a page either. My PD settings show 'Push only'. Can someone confirm manager got a call? :phone:

maria (manager): I got the SMS but my phone silenced the call. Just waking up, will join bridge.

ops-bridge-bot: Created incident bridge #bridge-B-11072 at https://meet.example/bridge-B-11072 — dial-in +1-800-555-0199.

alex (oncall): quick triage: 1) spike concentrated on a single model shard in us-east-1 behind eu-west-2 edge, 2) increased 429 + upstream 502s, 3) recent deployment 03/03 08:41 UTC changed scheduler. Starting hotfix rollback to previous scheduler config.

kevin: logs from inference-worker-1c show repeated 'cuda: out of memory' messages and kernel crashbacks. rolling one replica to fallback-quantized image.

maria (manager): joining bridge. taking lead — coordinating restore steps and customer comms. Alex keep the PD thread updated with who is leading.

alex (oncall): rollback command: `infractl deploy rollback inference-service --rev=2026-03-03-0839` — started. Also increasing autoscale limit on pool-shard-7: `kubectl patch hpa pool-shard-7 -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":20}}'`

pagerduty-bot: Manager acknowledgement recorded (maria) at 3629876572. Escalation chain closed.

kevin: rollback completed at 3629876588. Monitor shows error-rate dropping from 18% -> 7% over 3 minutes. One host still flapping; draining it now. `kubectl cordon inference-io-07 && kubectl drain --force inference-io-07`

ops-bridge-bot: Noting customer impact: some interactive customers experienced elevated latency and 5xxs for ~12m. Posting interim status to status page and support.

maria (manager): noted cause: problematic scheduler flags + a single shard underprovisioned after recent weight change. Immediate actions: rollback, scale shard, drain flapping host, route 25% traffic to eu-central fallback.

alex (oncall): routing command issued: `trafficctl shift --from eu-west-2 --to eu-central --percent=25 --selector=region-proxy` — changes applied. p95 down to 800ms, errors at 3%.

kevin: suggestion for follow-up: add SMS fallback to second-level escalation for PD policy; mobile-only pushes are unreliable for some on-call. Also suggest PD rule: if secondary ack fails, try paging different contact methods before manager escalation.

maria (manager): agreed. Filing task: PROD-OPS-1152 "Audit escalation policy + SMS fallback". Owner: maria.

alex (oncall): handing off operational notes and log snippets to kevin for RCA. I'll keep monitoring offline.

ops-bridge-bot: Incident B-11072 marked 'in progress' — next auto-update in 10 minutes.

kevin: created a short timeline in the bridge: 08:41 deploy with new scheduler -> 08:47 first 5xxs -> 08:50 PD alert -> 08:51 escalation chain -> 08:53 rollback started -> 08:58 rollback complete -> 09:02 errors within acceptable range.

maria (manager): posting update: "Mitigation in place: rollback and traffic shift completed; teams are monitoring. We'll post a detailed postmortem and timeline once logs are consolidated." Next update 20 minutes.

alex (oncall): dropping off. Thanks all for quick responses. :thumbsup:

kevin: collecting core dumps and kube events, will attach to RCA ticket.

IncidentBot: Incident B-11072 remains open for monitoring.
